subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and hosting profiles

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the full readiness contract in this PR, including four built-in profiles, operator-composed profiles, three profile-selection surfaces, and a public plugin readiness callback API?
rationale: These additions become permanent availability, configuration, startup, HTTP, CLI, and external plugin SDK contracts, so implementation quality alone cannot determine their accepted scope.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Adopt canonical projection of existing Gateway readiness and the thin CLI first, while deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-up work.

options.title: Approve the full RFC
options.body: Accept all proposed public surfaces, then require the outstanding code repair and exact-head packaged upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Keep the existing fixed evaluator and close the implementation after documenting which hosting use cases remain unsupported.

recommendation.title: Narrow the first release
recommendation.body: Adopt canonical projection of existing Gateway readiness and the thin CLI first, while deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current readiness implementation and has the strongest history across the affected contract surfaces.
